Return each qualifying session along with the corresponding path and search type.
sql:
WITH first_click AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_detail_click
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE path LIKE '%/detail%' OR path = '/complete'
    GROUP BY session
),
pre_click_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        f.session,
        COUNT(a.stamp) as pre_click_count
    FROM first_click f
    LEFT JOIN activity_log a ON f.session = a.session 
        AND a.stamp < f.first_detail_click
        AND a.search_type IS NOT NULL 
        AND a.search_type != ''
    GROUP BY f.session
),
min_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_click_count) as min_val
    FROM pre_click_counts
),
qualifying_sessions AS (
    SELECT session FROM pre_click_counts pc
    WHERE pc.pre_click_count = (SELECT min_val FROM min_count)
)
SELECT qs.session, pc.pre_click_count
FROM qualifying_sessions qs
JOIN pre_click_counts pc ON qs.session = pc.session
ORDER BY qs.session

min_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_click_count) as min_val
    FROM pre_click_counts
),
qualifying_sessions AS (
    SELECT session FROM pre_click_counts pc
    WHERE pc.pre_click_count = (SELECT min_val FROM min_count)
)
SELECT qs.session, pc.pre_click_count
FROM qualifying_sessions qs
JOIN pre_click_counts pc ON qs.session = pc.session
ORDER BY qs.session
